definitions: A powerful automation platform within Salesforce that allows administrators and developers to build complex business processes, user interfaces, and integrations without writing extensive code.
A collection of tools within Salesforce, including Screen Flows, Autolaunched Flows, and Record-Triggered Flows, used to automate workflows and guide users through processes.
examples: We implemented a Salesforce Flow to automate lead assignment.
The new user onboarding process is managed by a Salesforce Flow.
Debugging a complex Salesforce Flow can be challenging.
